messages:
natalie: dropped a quick prototype for the review-grid (shows tests as cards with acceptance criteria preview). need UX + a11y eyeballs before i add to spec. link: https://figma.com/file/review-grid-proto
sam: nice. two immediate asks: make the card focus target large (48px) and ensure the acceptance preview truncates gracefully with a 'Show more' control that is keyboard and SR accessible.
kevin: also consider a density toggle: Compact / Cozy. Compact hides the long preview but shows a one-liner summary and comment dot. Cozy shows full acceptance criteria inline. Users should be able to persist preference.
mira: agree on toggle. For SR users, the toggle should be a segmented control with aria-pressed states rather than a visual-only switch.
oliver: microcopy: top header currently says 'Regressions'. i'd prefer we switch to 'Changes' and badge specific items with 'Regression' when score drops past threshold. Less alarming in dashboards.
natalie: good call. i'll change header to 'Changes' and add Regression badges in-card when delta < -0.05.
priya: bulk approve flow: proposal is a two-step modal: 1) quick validation summary (warnings + errors), 2) confirmation with option 'Approve runs' and subtitle 'Audit entry will be created'. If errors exist (e.g., no tests), block the approve.
ux-helper: Suggestion: Pre-approve checks should include empty prompts, missing reference outputs, and test count == 0. Classify as error (block) vs warning (approve anyway). Provide keyboard-accessible 'Approve anyway' for warnings.
sam: accessibility: when modal opens, focus must land on the primary CTA and the modal should have role="dialog" with aria-labelledby. If we auto-focus primary CTA, ensure users can reach the close button quickly.
kevin: undo: after bulk approve, show a toast with 'Undo' (tabbable) and aria-live polite announce like 'Approved 14 runs. Undo available'. Also persist audit so team can revert.
mira: reduced-motion: when toggling Compact/Cozy or expanding preview, respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also ensure color isn't the only signal for deltas—add an up/down icon and textual delta.
oliver: comment handling: in Compact show a comment dot with count; activating it opens a flyout with threaded messages. Flyout should be reachable via keyboard (Enter) and closable with Escape. aria-label="Open comments for <test>".
priya: tiny copy nits: change CTA to 'Approve runs' (not 'Approve selected') and use sentence-case for badges (e.g., 'Regression', 'Change detected'). Keeps consistency with other console pieces.
natalie: tracking: i'll update the prototype with: header -> 'Changes', CTA -> 'Approve runs', pre-approve modal + classifications, compact/cozy toggle, comment dot flyout, aria-live toast undo, reduced-motion compliance, and persisting density preference. i'll ping when updated for a final pass. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
